facility.name: A Child's Discovery
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Get Well Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1853 E FM 2369, UVALDE, TX, 78801

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: 2 caregivers completed the first aid CPR course online only and no CPR Mankin was used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 3 of 4 caregivers were missing 3 required trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director was missing 3 required trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: The directors first aid/CPR had expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One caregiver did not have a current First Aid training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Two classrooms were over ratio by one child in each room with one caregiver.     These were corrected at inspection when one child was moved to another room and the other was corrected when another caregiver remained in classroom to have two total caregivers for one room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Several mats observed in the classrooms were torn and the foam was exposed.    Corrected at inspection: The torn mats were removed from the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The mats were not labeled with the name nor a number system.    Corrected at inspection: The mats were labeled with the child's name during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The indoor/outdoor policy was not in the operational policies provided to the parents.    Corrected inspection: The indoor/outdoor policy was added to the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection was last conducted on 02/25/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection was last completed on 02/25/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Two out of six children admission forms reviewed were lacking the doctor name and address under the health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of six children records were lacking an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: During the investigation inspection it was observed the center did not fill out the infant daily report and provide it to parents at the time of pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A classroom with children between 2-4 years old was observed to be out of ratio. The specified age group for the classroom was 2 years old with one caregiver and there were a total of 15 children. The classroom was out of ratio by 4 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: The permit capacity is 52 children and there were 53 children present at the center.    Corrected at inspection: A child was sent home during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The toddler classroom had a total of 14 children in care with the specified age group of 2 years old with one caregiver. The classroom was over ratio by 3 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: A caregiver observed in a classroom supervising children alone does not have CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: A caregiver observed to be supervising child alone did not have first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: The toddler classroom did not have any working lights on besides the bathroom light.    Corrected at inspection: They moved the children into another room that had working lights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Record Storage- Location: The personnel files were not at the center.    Corrected at inspection: A person had to bring the files to the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Record Storage- Location (26 TAC §746.907(c))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The center was cited for ratios three times. The director is failing to ensure the classrooms are within ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The center could not provide a filled out monthly playground checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: An old broken diaper changing station was observed in the playground area. A small homemade kitchen play area was observed to be coming apart and have a screw sticking out. Broken and rusted wheels off of a toy were also observed in the playground area.    Corrected at inspection: All the broken items were removed from the playground area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The center could not provide an emergency safety documentation form that indicated any fire, severe weather, or lock down drills had been conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The centers second building had all the lights off including the classroom and hallway lights.    Corrected at inspection: The lights were turned on during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Recited: A classroom was observed to have 23 children in care with one caregiver. The youngest in the classroom was 16 months the oldest was 10 years old. The specified age group was 4 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Recited: The operational policy was lacking the indoor/outdoor policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: A caregiver could not tell me the ages of the children in their care, they did not have a list that had the children's name or date of birth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Two classrooms were observed out of ratio. The infant classroom had 6 infants with the specified age group of 0-11 months with one caregiver. The second classroom had a total of 17 children with  one classroom with the specified age group of 2 years old with one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy was lacking the indoor/outdoor policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age: There were 6 infants in the classroom and there are only 4 cribs in the classroom.     Corrected at inspection: They add pack-n-play's into the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children: A 4 month old child was observed in a classroom with a 4 year old.    Corrected at inspection: They separated the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.2403(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A walker was observed in an infant classroom.    Corrected at inspection: It was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A class was observed watching a cartoon and there were infants in the classroom.    Corrected at inspection: They turned off the television and moved the infants into another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink: An infant room did not have a sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The CPSC certificate was not signed or posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
